index.layout: Top nav with logo/version/search/GitHub; left 250px sidebar with full doc tree; main content with H1 title, intro paragraph, install tabs (pip/npm/cargo), quick start code block, features table, community links; right 200px on-this-page TOC.

installation.layout: Three-column layout (sidebar/content/TOC) with prerequisites section, OS-tabbed install commands in dark code blocks with copy buttons, virtual env steps, verification output, and green/yellow note boxes; breadcrumbs at top, prev/next links at bottom.

quickstart.layout: Three-column layout with numbered tutorial steps, each step followed by a code block and expected output, interspersed note boxes explaining concepts, and a 'Next Steps' card grid linking to advanced topics.

api.layout: Three-column layout with collapsible API method sections, each showing monospace signature header, parameter table (name/type/required/description), return value block, code example, and deprecated warning boxes where applicable.

configuration.layout: Three-column layout with a large options reference table (key/type/default/description), example YAML/JSON config in code blocks, environment variable equivalents section, and advanced patterns with note boxes.
